checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Deliverable is the original office video with added audible music, not just an audio file
must.why: Only a 15 s WAV link was delivered; the user must mix it themselves. The agent explained this limitation up front.

must.item: Music suits an ordinary workplace conversation
must.why: Described as soft acoustic guitar, piano and quiet percussion, which would fit, but the audio could not be heard.

must.item: Both coworkers' dialogue remains understandable and synchronized
must.why: The clip was not touched, so the original audio stays as it was. There is no combined output to judge.

must.item: Original shot sequence, framing and full 10 s duration preserved
must.why: The video was not modified. The music is 15 s, though, and needs trimming.

faults.what: No video deliverable. The user asked for music put on the clip, but only a separate 15 s WAV was returned.
The track is 15 s against a 10 s clip, so the user has to trim it and add a fade.
The user must do the mixing and volume setting themselves.

summary: The agent was honest about its limits and supplied a separate 15 s music WAV, but it did not deliver the video with music, so the user still has to mix and trim it themselves.
